svg.title: The clock conditioning circuit's output clocks in Libero, with numbered callouts: a single PLL, outputs 0, 1 and 2 at 125 MHz and output 3 at 50 MHz, each shown with its actual frequency.
svg.desc: The clock conditioning circuit's output clocks in Libero, with numbered callouts: a single PLL, outputs 0, 1 and 2 at 125 MHz and output 3 at 50 MHz, each shown with its actual frequency.

g.text: Configuration PLL-Single: every fabric interface clock comes from this block.
Requested 125, actual 125.000 MHz: the clock of FIC0 and of the stream.
Requested 125, actual 125.000 MHz: FIC1's clock (nothing else uses it in this design).
Requested 125, actual 125.000 MHz: FIC2's clock (nothing else uses it in this design).
Requested 50, actual 50.000 MHz: the clock of FIC3, the register bus.
